mutants.label: remove name guard
mutants.find:
if "/" in name or "\\" in name or name == "..":
        raise ValidationError(f"invalid snapshot name: {name!r}")

mutants.label: validate after mkdir
mutants.find:
if "/" in name or "\\" in name or name == "..":
        raise ValidationError(f"invalid snapshot name: {name!r}")
mutants.replace:
snapshots = world / "snapshots"
    snapshots.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if "/" in name or "\\" in name or name == "..":
        raise ValidationError(f"invalid snapshot name: {name!r}")

mutants.label: message-only control
mutants.why: The contract asserts the error type and filesystem effect, not punctuation in its message.
